svg.title: Major issues flagged by an AI referee
svg.desc: Matched-field comparison: 130 AI papers, rounded 84 percent with 95 percent bootstrap CI 78-90; 50 control papers, 76 percent, CI 64-88. AI referee judgments, not independent human verdicts. Selected sample, not all scientific work.
svg.text: Major issues flagged by an AI referee
Share flagged with at least one major issue
Dot: reported share · line: 95% bootstrap confidence interval
These are AI-referee judgments, not human-confirmed error rates.
Source: frozen JCCM public aggregates · plotted values rounded to integers
